Sheet 'Historical Projects (1996-2024)', Excel row 1145: the same project name, Iroquois Pipeline Co, NY to NY, 650 MMcf/d, $75 million, FERC docket CP13-502, status 'Cancelled', project notes 'Built in conjunction with Constitution Pipeline'. The historical row matches the GEM row exactly (cost $75M, 650 MMcf/d), which identifies the GEM row as the cancelled original; the live row is the same project revived.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: REVIVED PROJECT: Wright Interconnect was cancelled in 2020 (certificate vacated) but Iroquois filed with FERC on 2/17/2026 (CP13-502-003) to reinstate. As of May 2026, status changed to Pre-applied. Targets May 2028 in-service. This is a rare case of a cancelled project being revived. Status should change from cancelled to proposed. ORCHESTRATOR CORRECTION 2026-09-14: CONFIRMED in the main loop, and the proposed changes were CONTRADICTORY as first staged: they set Status='proposed' while also setting ShelvedCancelledType='confirmed'. A proposed row carries no shelved/cancelled marker at all, so ShelvedCancelledType, CancelledYear ('2020') and ShelvedYear ('2018') are all cleared instead. ProposalYear is FILLED as 2013 rather than 2026: the blank is an owed unit, and FERC docket CP13-502 on the historical EIA row dates the original proposal to 2013; the 2026 filing is docket CP13-502-003, an amendment reinstating that same vacated certificate, not a new proposal. Tier low for that inference. FLAG for the reviewer: if GEM's convention is to re-date a revived project to its revival, ProposalYear should be 2026 instead -- state the convention and this row follows it. SegmentCost is raised from $75,000,000 to $152,000,000, the figure on the live EIA row. The sheet's existing ShelvedCancelledType was 'inferred', so, as with P3199, the cancellation was never sourced -- it was deduced from dormancy, and the dormancy has now ended. | ORCHESTRATOR 2026-09-14: tier demoted to medium and independent -> false.
